title: Market listing + co-sell: CloudBridge integration & sales motion
text:
Market listing + co-sell: CloudBridge integration & sales motion

['From: Samir Nadeem <samir@cloudbridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Potential listing + co-sell: integration surface and go-to-market sync

Hi Jordan and Olga,

Really appreciate the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and pricing controls in Redwood Dedicated. CloudBridge is preparing our marketplace catalog updates for Q2 and we think Redwood would be a strong fit for our AI infra category.

Before we start the formal onboarding, engineering wants a concise integration surface so they can estimate implementation effort for the listing tiles and API proxy. Can you share:
- a short tech spec (supported endpoint paths, auth patterns, payload size limits)
- recommended SKU/plan mapping for co-sell attribution
- any reseller/entitlement gotchas we should flag to our catalog team

If it helps, I can loop in our partner engineering reviewer (Priya) — she’s copied on this thread. Hoping we can get something by end of week so our product ops can slot Redwood into the April release.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Partnerships, CloudBridge
[CloudBridge logo svg]', 'From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Nadeem <samir@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Potential listing + co-sell: integration surface and go-to-market sync

Samir — thanks for the clear ask and for the fast follow-up. Happy to move forward.

Short answers up top:
- Tech spec: I attached a one-page integration summary and a link to our public API reference. It covers endpoints, auth (API keys + optional mTLS for Private), payload limits, and common error codes.
- SKU mapping: we propose three SKUs for marketplace visibility: Hosted-API (pay-as-you-go), Dedicated-Burst (reserved + burst), Private-Enterprise (VPC). We’ll include suggested metering events for co-sell attribution.
- Gotchas: entitlements require mapping customer org IDs to the CloudBridge marketplace account; some private deployments need a signed MSA for cloudbrokered entitlements.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal Redwood sync: Olga, Vivek, Ben — can we produce the compact partner-facing integration spec and co-sell playbook draft by Thursday EOD?
2) Technical review with Priya & CloudBridge eng: Thurs or Fri — 30m to validate the auth flow and SKU metering.
3) I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan once we confirm dates.

Jordan Blake
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-cosell-playbook-v0.3.docx]
[Attachment: cloudbridge-integration-specs-v1.pdf]

On Tue, Feb 14, 2028 at 09:12 AM Samir Nadeem <samir@cloudbridge.io> wrote:
> Hi Jordan and Olga,
> 
> Really appreciate the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and pricing controls in Redwood Dedicated....', "From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Action items for CloudBridge listing + co-sell (CB-4721)

Team — quick internal coordination to hit Samir's timeline. Summary from the external thread above included. Priority: produce a concise partner-facing packet and confirm a technical review slot.

Ask breakdown (owners & targets):
- Olga: finalize the integration one-pager (auth, endpoints, error handling) — Thurs EOD. Use the API reference link in the draft.
- Vivek: pricing/SKU mapping and suggested metering events for CloudBridge's catalog — Thurs EOD. Note: propose both pay-as-you-go and Dedicated commit options.
- Ben: update co-sell playbook to include our recommended sales motions for marketplace leads (MQL qualification, demo assets, credit offers) — Friday noon.

Candidate times for technical review with CloudBridge (30m): Thurs 3:00pm PT, Fri 10:00am PT. Please indicate availability.

Keep the packet short (1–2 pages per doc). Samir specifically wants something their product ops can slot into April release notes.

Thanks — Jordan
Head of Alliances

----Original message attached below----", "From: Samir Nadeem <samir@cloudbridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@alpha-consult.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Potential listing + co-sell: integration surface and go-to-market sync

Jordan / Olga — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Priya did a first-pass review and asked a couple of clarifying questions (copied below). We’re good to proceed to the catalog intake once we align on these small items: 

Priya (Alpha Consulting) notes:
- For the entitlement mapping, is there a supported automated webhook for provisioning or is the current flow manual via our resale portal?
- For Dedicated SKU metering: can you confirm the event names and whether we expose usage aggregates (daily/hourly) for marketplace reconciliation?

Jordan — can your team confirm before EOD tomorrow? If yes, we’ll lock CloudBridge Q2 catalog slot and open the co-sell enablement task in our partner portal.

Appended: Priya's inline comments and the proposed time for a 30m tech sanity call next week.

Thanks,
Samir
Sr. Partnerships, CloudBridge
[Attachment: cloudbridge-integration-specs-v1.pdf]"]
